Dragoneer Investment Group LLC Lifted Jd Com INC (JD) Stake by $18.41 Million Posted by Duane Lopez on December 9, 2018 at 2:39 pm
Dragoneer Investment Group Llc increased its stake in Jd Com Inc (JD) by 36.2% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dragoneer Investment Group Llc bought 484,601 shares as the company’s stock declined 33.02% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 1.82M shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $71.02M, up from 1.34 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dragoneer Investment Group Llc who had been investing in Jd Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $30.28B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.41% or $0.3 during the last trading session, reaching $20.93. About 13.48 million shares traded. JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) has declined 36.17% since December 9, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 51.79% the S&P500.
